_comment_org_default: This repository is ancaria-dev/.github. It is both the org-wide fallback Renovate uses for a repository with no config of its own, and the shared preset every component repository extends explicitly as ["github>ancaria-dev/.github:renovate"], so this is the one place to define the dependencies.json custom manager instead of copying it into every consumer.

customManagers.description: Cross-repository GitHub Release artifacts pinned in dependencies.json (launcher, mods, and every scaffolded SRML mod repository). Never resolved from Maven or npm, so neither Dependabot nor Renovate's built-in managers see them without this.

packageRules.description: dependencies.json entries tag their releases v<version>, but the file stores the bare version -- match that shape everywhere the custom manager applies.
